metadata.title: Billing integrity hardening
metadata.description: Close replay, payment-loss, stale-hold, concurrency, expiry, subscription, and confidence gaps found by the billing review.
objectives: Make every paid provider invocation use a server-owned billing operation id.
Keep wallet, usage, quota, and payment state consistent under retries, failures, and concurrency.
Make disabled subscription code safe before it is enabled.
Add executable regressions for every confirmed defect.
assumptions: PAYG and lead magnet remain the active production billing modes.
Subscription purchase endpoints remain feature-flagged off but must be correct before enablement.
No new runtime dependency is needed.

task-1-1.title: Use server-owned operation ids and wallet-scoped idempotency

details: Remove client control over financial identifiers
Scope ledger and usage uniqueness to the owning wallet
Add replay regression tests

task-1-2.title: Enforce hold, balance expiry, daily-cap, and usage atomicity

details: Release expired and cancelled holds
Reserve daily cap atomically
Keep settlement and usage records consistent
Enforce included and top-up expiry semantics

task-2-1.title: Make top-up processing retryable, validated, and concurrency-safe

details: Propagate crediting failures
Validate amount and currency against local payment
Claim one auto-topup per wallet
Return exact reconciliation result to the UI

task-2-2.title: Make subscription activation atomic and grant the purchased plan

details: Do not mark payment complete before entitlement
Switch to the purchased plan
Grant period credit idempotently
Ignore expired subscriptions in PAYG preflight

task-3-1.title: Make lead-magnet and subscription quota consumption atomic

details: Reserve quota before provider work
Prevent lost updates
Roll back reservations when provider work fails

task-3-2.title: Restore billing API tests and add defect regressions

details: Fix async mock user helper
Add webhook failure, stream cancellation, replay, expiry, and concurrency tests

verify-4-1.title: Billing critical suites and confidence gates pass

metadata.expected: All billing critical backend, frontend, and E2E suites pass

verify-4-2.title: Migration, lint, typecheck, and manual reproductions pass

metadata.command: Run migration round-trip, targeted pytest/vitest, ruff, frontend check, and the original replay/cancellation reproductions
metadata.expected: No regression, dirty schema, or unresolved billing blocker remains
